name: iam:PassRole + ec2:RequestSpotInstances
description: Request an EC2 spot instance with a privileged IAM instance profile and inject malicious user-data that runs with the role's credentials on launch. Unlike ec2:RunInstances this attack vector uses the spot market API, which may be overlooked in permission reviews.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Pass the target instance profile role to the spot instance

additional.description: Poll spot request status until fulfilled

admin: IAM instance profile with administrative permissions must exist
VPC with at least one subnet for instance placement
lateral: Principal with iam:PassRole scoped to the target instance profile role

references.title: AWS Privilege Escalation Methods - Rhino Security Labs

techniques: T1098.001 - Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Credentials

options.name: INSTANCE_PROFILE
options.description: Target IAM instance profile name to pass to the spot instance

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for the spot instance request

options.name: AMI_ID
options.description: AMI ID for the spot instance (auto-detects Amazon Linux 2023 if not specified)

options.name: INSTANCE_TYPE
options.description: EC2 instance type for the spot request

options.name: SUBNET_ID
options.description: Subnet ID for instance placement (uses default VPC if not specified)

options.name: SPOT_WAIT_TIMEOUT
options.description: Seconds to wait for spot request fulfillment (demo calibrated: 180)

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Cancel spot request and terminate instance after execution (requires ec2:CancelSpotInstanceRequests and ec2:TerminateInstances; starting user typically lacks these)

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach AdministratorAccess policy to an IAM user or role via EC2 user-data

payloads.name: backdoor/create-access-key
payloads.description: Create access keys for an existing IAM user via EC2 user-data

payloads.name: backdoor/create-role
payloads.description: Create an IAM role with administrator privileges and custom trust policy via EC2 user-data

payloads.name: backdoor/create-user
payloads.description: Create an IAM user with administrator privileges and optional console/programmatic access via EC2 user-data

payloads.name: backdoor/update-role-trust
payloads.description: Append a trust policy statement to an existing IAM role via EC2 user-data

payloads.name: exfil/https
payloads.description: Exfiltrate instance role credentials to an attacker-controlled HTTPS endpoint via EC2 user-data

payloads.name: exfil/s3
payloads.description: Exfiltrate EC2 instance role credentials to an attacker-controlled S3 bucket via user-data
